name: finetune_ood
_purpose: EXPERIMENT, not the default. Fine-tunes the base checkpoint with 25% randomised synthetic structure (gratings, contact arrays, step edges) mixed into the training targets, to test whether it improves the out-of-distribution half of the score. Launch with --init_from weights/base_best.pt. Ship only if it wins on BOTH evaluate.py (in-distribution val) and ood_check.py; a gain on one at the cost of the other is not a win.
_lr_note: 5e-5, a quarter of the base run's rate: this is a fine-tune, and a full-rate restart would discard what the 110-epoch run learned.
